quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.lead: Quotes for clients: drafts, sent quotes and client replies. A quote gets its number when it is sent.
quotes.createDenied: You are not allowed to create quotes

empty.title: No quotes yet
empty.description: Create the first quote for a client: lines, discounts and totals, then send it.

submit.description: Only drafts are sent: each gets a number and can no longer be changed. Quotes in other statuses stay as they are, the report lists them with the reason.
submit.denied: You are not allowed to send quotes
submit.notAllowed: Only a draft can be sent

cancel.description: The quotes become void but stay in the list. One reason for all, it shows in the history of each. Drafts are not cancelled but deleted.
cancel.denied: You are not allowed to cancel quotes
cancel.notAllowed: Only a sent quote can be cancelled: a draft is deleted, a cancelled one is already cancelled

delete.description: Only drafts without a number are deleted, for good. A sent quote is not deleted but cancelled: such quotes stay, the report lists them with the reason.

quote.title: Quote

order.exists: An order has already been created from this quote

submit.title: Send the quote?
submit.description: The quote gets a number and can no longer be changed. Mistakes are fixed by cancelling it and creating a corrected copy.

decline.title: Did the client decline the quote?
decline.description: The quote becomes declined. You can add the reason to know it later.

quote.editDenied: You are not allowed to edit quotes

locked.submitted: A sent quote cannot be changed: cancel it and create a corrected copy
locked.cancelled: A cancelled quote cannot be changed: create a corrected copy
locked.linked: An order was created from this quote: cancel or delete it first

delete.denied: You are not allowed to delete quotes
delete.title: Delete the draft?
delete.description: The draft is deleted for good together with its lines. It has no number yet, so numbering does not change.
delete.descriptionAmended: The draft is deleted for good together with its lines. The cancelled quote it was made from can be corrected again.

locked.submitted: A sent quote is not deleted: cancel it
locked.cancelled: A cancelled quote is not deleted: it stays in the history

quote.linesInvalid: The quote lines could not be shown

form.copyOf: Copy of "{{title}}". The new quote appears after you select Save.
form.validUntilBefore: Not earlier than the quote date

orders.title: Orders
orders.lead: Client orders: drafts, confirmed and completed orders. An order gets its number when it is confirmed.
orders.createDenied: You are not allowed to create orders

empty.title: No orders yet
empty.description: Create the first client order: lines, discounts and totals, then confirm it.

submit.description: Only drafts are confirmed: each gets a number and can no longer be changed. Orders in other statuses stay as they are, the report lists them with the reason.
submit.denied: You are not allowed to confirm orders
submit.notAllowed: Only a draft can be confirmed

complete.description: Only confirmed orders are marked as completed. Drafts, completed and cancelled orders stay as they are, the report lists them with the reason.
complete.denied: You are not allowed to mark orders as completed
complete.notAllowed: Only a confirmed order can be marked as completed

cancel.description: The orders become void but stay in the list. One reason for all, it shows in the history of each. Drafts are not cancelled but deleted.
cancel.denied: You are not allowed to cancel orders
cancel.notAllowed: Only a confirmed or completed order can be cancelled: a draft is deleted, a cancelled one is already cancelled

delete.description: Only drafts without a number are deleted, for good. A confirmed order is not deleted but cancelled: such orders stay, the report lists them with the reason.

order.title: Order

submit.title: Confirm the order?
submit.description: The order gets a number and can no longer be changed. A mistake is fixed by cancelling it and making a new copy.

invoice.exists: An invoice has already been issued from this order

order.editDenied: You are not allowed to change orders

locked.submitted: A confirmed order is not changed: cancel it and make a corrected copy
locked.cancelled: A cancelled order is not changed: make a corrected copy
locked.linked: Submitted documents were created from this order: cancel them first

delete.denied: You are not allowed to delete orders
delete.title: Delete the draft?
delete.description: The draft is deleted for good with its lines. It has no number yet, so numbering does not change.
delete.descriptionAmended: The draft is deleted for good with its lines. The cancelled order it was made from can be corrected again.

locked.submitted: A confirmed order is not deleted: cancel it
locked.cancelled: A cancelled order is not deleted: it stays in the history

order.linesInvalid: Could not show the order lines

orderForm.copyOf: Copy of "{{title}}". The new order appears after you select Save.
orderForm.dueDateBefore: Not earlier than the order date
